text:
Anya: Quick note from overnight canary for quant-rerank v2 — small overall lift but a suspicious long-tail hit on the `support` slice. putting raw snapshots below.

Kai: Ugh, can you paste the delta table?

Anya: Sure, short summary first — holdout was ~12.3k queries (sampled from prod). Control = prod-rerank-v1, Candidate = quant-rerank-v2.

Anya: ```
Control vs Candidate (holdout 12.3k)
metric     | control  | candidate | delta
RR@1       | 0.842    | 0.835     | -0.007 (-0.83%)
MRR        | 0.712    | 0.708     | -0.004 (-0.56%)
Fidelity   | 0.940    | 0.926     | -0.014 (-1.49%)
Top-CTR    | 0.121    | 0.124     | +0.003 (+2.48%)
Support-slice RR@1 | 0.812 | 0.789 | -0.023 (-2.83%)
```

Sam: That support-slice delta is the thing. small overall but concentrated. Do we have sample diffs?

Anya: Pasted 3 manual sample pairs from the failing slice:
1) control: "Please reset your password by following the link."
candidate: "Try resetting pass via link." -> candidate drops rank, still ok
2) control: "I can't access my invoices."
candidate: "Invoices page blank for some users." -> candidate promotes an unrelated doc, worse relevance
3) control: "How do I update billing method?"
candidate: "You can change billing in settings." -> fine

Jess: Sounds like reranker is sensitive to short queries and entity mentions; quantization might be nudging embedding distances.

Mike: eval-bot posted an automated check this morning: 

eval-bot: ALERT: slice_support: RR@1 delta -2.83% exceeds configured warning threshold (-1.0%). Fidelity delta -1.49% exceeds soft alarm (-1.0%). No global rollback triggered because overall RR@1 delta < -1.0%.

Kai: What do our rollout rules say? current auto-fallback: if any slice RR@1 delta <= -2.0% -> immediate rollback; if any slice delta <= -1.0% -> pause and run targeted A/B.

Sam: Right now the slice is -2.83% so that would qualify for rollback. Did deploy-bot attempt to promote?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by policy: slice_violation detected for 'support'. Candidate not promoted.

Anya: I pushed a quick synthetic perturbation harness to replay failing queries with higher FP16-ish noise; reranker scores decay more under quantized weights. Will run a 50k replay. ETA ~45m.

Jess: For long-term, we should add a per-slice sensitivity feature to the promotion score (weight support higher for renewal/CS flows). Also add automatic tag so future quant experiments run targeted calibration for entity matches.

Mike: Proposal for auto-fallback tweak:
- immediate rollback if any critical slice RR@1 delta <= -2.5% OR fidelity delta <= -1.5%
- pause & quarantine + targeted A/B if any slice RR@1 delta in (-2.5%, -1.0%]
- require 2 consecutive holdout runs showing improvement before auto-promote

Kai: +1. Also add a short-circuit: if top-K concordance drop > 3% on any support-intent sub-slice -> rollback.

Sam: Action items:
- Anya: finish 50k replay and upload fail-pass sample set to S3 (s3://redwood-lab/quant-rerank/v2/failset).
- Jess: open a small followup to add sensitivity weight for support slice in rollout calculator.
- Mike: update rollout policy PR to new thresholds and add unit tests for short queries.
- Kai: if replay confirms, we either 1) calibrate quant params for v2 or 2) revert quantized weights and try a hybrid quant profile.

Anya: Replay job started (job-id: qr-replay-1768888888). I'll post results when done.

eval-bot: NOTE: tagging thread with metric-watch-id mw-2026-09-04-17 for audit.

Jess: thanks — also pinging @product (not in thread) to flag possible CX impact if this had slipped.

Sam: ok keeping this blocked from any staged promotions until follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Anya: Update — 50k replay finished: same direction, support-slice RR@1 delta -2.6%. Upload at s3://redwood-lab/quant-rerank/v2/replay-1768888888.csv

Mike: Given the confirmed replay, I'll open the rollback PR and mark v2 as "quarantine" in model catalog.

Kai: Good. Let's circle tomorrow after Jess's rollout-calculator PR lands.

Anya: Thanks everyone.
